leakage_check.reason: Positive pregnancy test (also the chief complaint) points to pregnancy, the common core of all three gold diagnoses; inherent to the case and does not separate normal, ectopic and molar pregnancy.
Refers to 'the pregnancy' (unplanned); presupposes pregnancy, inherent to the scripted counselling scenario.

source_issues: Gold diagnosis #1 lists 'Nausea and weight gain'; the patient has not weighed herself (p015) and reports only constant bloating, so weight gain is not supported by the script.
Gold diagnosis #3 lists 'Nausea', a symptom, under Physical Exam Findings. Kept as given in the source.
gold_additional_diagnosis is 'N/A'; additional_considerations is left empty.
Note OB/GYN says 'has regular periods 4-5 times per month', which garbles the script (periods last 3-4 days, monthly, 4-5 pads per day).
Heart rate: doorway 76/minute vs. 72 beats per minute in the note's heart exam (e006).
p008 also asks about protection against STIs; the answer (withdrawal) does not address condoms or STI protection. The note's 'coitus interruptus as the only method' goes slightly beyond the answer.
p017 asks whether her breasts hurt; the answer ('a little fuller than before. No discharge.') does not address pain. The note calls this 'bilateral breast engorgement'.
p004 is a multi-part answer that overlaps with p002 (light spotting at the last period) and p005 (no pain with periods).
Name inconsistency: opening 'Tanya Parker' vs. sample closure 'Ms. Park'.
annotator_notes: f018: 'I haven't weighed myself lately' is an unknown, not a denial; coded as a present statement with a flag because the schema has no 'unknown' polarity.
f017: 'I don't feel like eating anything because of the nausea' is decreased appetite, coded present (guide rule 2).
f046: 'Did you plan to conceive?' - 'No' is coded as a present unplanned pregnancy (the clinically meaningful item), consistent with the challenging question.
Usual menstrual pattern (f005-f008) is marked historical because her cycle is now interrupted by the missed period.
p002 and p004 both describe the last period as light spotting and are merged into f003.
'Single, with no children' from the SP-sheet patient description is placed in acting_notes because it has no valid source id.
leakage_check lists the facts that presuppose pregnancy; this is unavoidable in a case whose chief complaint is a positive pregnancy test.
